title: Can experience discover coordinates that make persistent operator writes separable?
question: Can useful computational coordinates and persistent-write coordinates self-align through experience rather than being supplied?
hypothesis: In a matched recurrent substrate with hidden resident modes, a basis learned only from passive trajectory covariance can align persistent adaptation with those dynamical coordinates well enough to recover a richer addressed written-operator family and stronger held-out operator composition than visible or fixed-random coordinates.
assumptions: The fast recurrent matrix, dimensionality, stimulation addresses, write law, state budget and observation budget are matched across coordinate strategies.
The learned arm receives covariance estimated from passive trajectories and does not read the oracle basis or fast matrix.
The synthetic hidden basis is a signed/permuted Hadamard family, deliberately making visible-coordinate address energy maximally mixed.
This is an existence/learnability calibration for one constructed symmetric linear world family, not evidence that arbitrary dense RNNs or biological systems discover such coordinates.

experiments.purpose: Learn coordinates from passive covariance, then freeze the basis and compare matched persistent-write/operator-composition behavior against visible, random, oracle and no-write controls.

attackers.claim_attacked: Any persistent adaptation coordinates are sufficient.
Any orthogonal change of coordinates is sufficient.
The learned arm may be using hidden extra capacity rather than partially recovering the useful coordinate system.
The composition signal exists without persistent operator rewrite.

gates.meaning: Across the eight-world panel, the worst learned basis produces a richer written-operator family than the best matched fixed-random basis.
Across the panel, the weakest learned basis preserves stronger held-out A/B order-sensitive composition than the strongest random-basis control.
Every learned basis must recover the hidden resident coordinate family up to sign and permutation, rather than winning through unrelated capacity.
Learning must improve the written-operator family over the maximally mixed visible-coordinate attacker.
The learned-basis gain must survive an operator-composition readout, not only a basis-similarity diagnostic.
The learned arm is bounded by the supplied modal upper control on operator-family richness.
The learned composition readout remains below the oracle coordinate control.
With the same oracle coordinates but zero persistent write gain, the held-out order-composition effect collapses.

if_pass: In this constructed matched recurrent family, passive covariance experience is sufficient to discover coordinates that make later persistent writes nearly as separable and compositionally effective as the supplied modal basis.
The result closes the narrow v1 missing-executor loop for one learnability calibration: useful write coordinates need not be supplied explicitly in this world.
if_fail: The proposed covariance learner does not earn coordinate self-alignment under the predeclared matched controls; basis alignment remains supplied rather than learned in TheoryLab.
always_limit: The hidden worlds are symmetric linear systems with deliberately Hadamard-mixed visible coordinates and distinct modal variances, a setting favorable to covariance learning.
This does not establish that generic local plasticity, arbitrary nonlinear RNNs, dendrites, or biological systems discover the same coordinates.
PCA/power iteration is a global covariance learner, not yet the Oja/local-learning version suggested by the older SimpleNeuron lineage.

limitations: Visible coordinates are deliberately a hard attacker: each hidden address has identical squared visible-coordinate energy.
The coordinate learner sees a covariance sufficient statistic rather than raw streaming samples.
The composition readout is a normalized operator/probe-bank separation score, not an external semantic task.
A stronger next gate should replace batch covariance eigendecomposition with an online/local learner and test coordinate drift.

provenance.question: Can useful computational coordinates and persistent write self-align through experience?

provenance.note: Same-fast-matrix visible versus modal adaptation made coordinate alignment load-bearing but supplied.
Motivated modal computational identity, basis continuation and basis reorientation as reusable coordinates.
